chunks: And in another report, he said:
"There is no harm in giving on behalf of yourself and those whom you support to a single person."

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Can Zakat al-Fitrah for oneself and one's dependents be given to one recipient?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal allowance regarding Zakat al-Fitrah: a person may give the fitrah for himself and his dependents to one single recipient. It indicates flexibility in distribution and clarifies that dividing it among multiple recipients is not required in this case.
